title: Taylor Swift among prominent celebrities at MSG for NBA Finals Game 4
content:
Madison Square Garden will have a new famous face in celebrity row for Game 4 of the NBA Finals between the New York Knicks and the San Antonio Spurs.

Or maybe Taylor Swift might just be scouting out her future wedding destination.

The 14-time Grammy Award-winning artist joined the Knicks’ famous celebrity row for Game 4, with her wedding to Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce reportedly scheduled for July 3 at the Garden.

Swift is expected to sit courtside with the rest of the Knicks’ celebrity contingent, including mainstays Spike Lee, Ben Stiller and Fat Joe, on Wednesday.

It’s not the first NBA playoff game Swift has attended this year. Alongside Kelce, Swift was sitting courtside for Game 3 of the NBA Eastern Conference Finals in Cleveland between the Cleveland Cavaliers and the Knicks. Kelce is a Cleveland native and a known Cavaliers fan. However, both Swift and Kelce were condemned to watching Jalen Brunson score 30 points and lead his Knicks to a 121-108 win over Cleveland to go up 3-0 in that series on the way to a 4-0 sweep.
